snippet.title: BetterGH3 - Release Trailer
snippet.description:
BetterGH3 is an all-in-one package that gives you the definitive near-vanilla console experience in one portable, easy-to-install bundle!

*GET IT HERE* (Please read README.txt):
Current version: v1.0.2
Google Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1gJgm-GjJ70KZ3hVzlDR8e8AQy_Y8D9RU
MEGA: https://mega.nz/folder/xdES1YpL#tj9dxP5H9P35jtASlKIVHw
MediaFire: https://www.mediafire.com/folder/abryhgsjw097z/BetterGH3

*Need help? Found a bug? Just wanna chill with the community?* Join NeverHax!
https://discord.gg/FcZ7yX3rNY
^^   Please report game-related issues here, *NOT in Warehouse!*

Unlock everything: https://www.tiktok.com/@fregrb/video/7565422643935989012
